findings.message: PROCESS, not a defect: the recorded adversarial pass on revision-42a78a3b returned ONE major finding and nothing else (all other claims refuted), fixed in d6c19f8 — `selectionFor` took the candidate state from the workspace's primary candidate while the id came from the picker, so choosing a stopped sibling of a running primary recorded `running` and choosing a running sibling of a stopped primary answered `target-stopped`. Re-sealing so the record matches the tree.
